description: Get a single note by UUID, slug, or title. Use this to read the full content of individual notes, including brain source notes referenced in a brain manifest. VAULT SYNC STATUS: the response carries a sync block — status is "queued" (commit in flight), "synced" (landed; see file_path + commit_sha), "failed" (see last_error; the sweeper retries), or "none" (no vault target). This is how you confirm a deferred post_notes commit landed; post_notes itself can only report "queued".
name: get_note
title: Get Note
